## Requirements File

Copy the block below into a `requirements.txt` file and run
`pip install -r requirements.txt` to install everything you need.

```
requests
pandas
tqdm
PyMuPDF
pdfminer.six
pdfplumber
spacy
transformers
sentence-transformers
torch
networkx
pyvis
matplotlib
jupyter
ipykernel
```

After installing, download the spaCy English model:

```bash
python -m spacy download en_core_web_sm
```
